       Overview                                                                     
                                                                                    
       This document describes the Firebolt app services, which can be used by portable Firebolt apps.
                                                                                    
       Native Player App Service - org.rdk.nativeplayer                             
                                                                                    
       This app service offers functionality to play live IP native channels.       
           Method    Parameters Returns       Specific errors API version Description Open issues
                                                                                    
       1  playLive            None            None      1.0.0 Play a live channel   
                       channelId - string                                           
       2  stop      None      None            None      1.0.0                       
       3  status / onStatusChanged None       None      1.0.0                       
                                state - enum                                        
                                  idle                                              
                                  pending                                           
                                  playing                                           
                                  blocked                                           
                                  failed                                            
                                blockedReason - enum                                
                                  parental                                          
                                  other                                             
                                channelId - string                                  
                                currentPositionSeconds - unsigned                   
                                endPositionSeconds - unsigned                       
       Parental App Service - org.rdk.parental                                      
       This app service offers PIN and parental control functionality.              
           Method Parameters Returns Specific API Description            Open       
                             errors version                              issues     
       1  pinChallen None           1.0.0 Requests to raise a PIN prompt to the user, verify any PIN supplied by the user, and
          ge            proceed no      return whether to proceed or not            
                        - bool service                                              
                              service                                               
                              failed                                                
                              app not                                               
                              active
